The '''Cydorria system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] known as the [[Cydorrian driller tree]].<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cydorria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-13.<ref name="TEA" />
